# Test fixture catalog

`catalog.jsonl` is a hand-written, four-row synthetic fixture. It exists only
to test packaging, retrieval mechanics, and evidence checks without downloading
or copying the ABO catalog.

- It is not real product data.
- It is not an ABO subset.
- It must not be used for retrieval-quality or licence claims.
- The Stage 06 catalog and provenance files will replace it for demos.
